text: In Mac, committing it fullscreen does not actually make it fullscreen. Also, there’s a window sizing issue on my MacBook. In its normal (non-maximized) state, the window is larger than the screen, so parts of it get cut off. When I click maximize, the window actually shrinks. And even then it’s not true full screen: it just stretches to the screen’s width and height, rather than going into proper macOS full-screen mode.

You should add an option to save the lyrics in the device (android and windows). You should add an option to save the lyrics of a song in lrc format to use the lyrics in other older mp3 players (like old car players).

Mobile-TV sync and QR code based sign in. Mobile-TV sync means controlling TV app songs via the app on the phone on the same network/account. QR code based login for tv apps where i can scan the code from the app and Authorize the tv app with my sign in creds to be signed in on the tv without me entering those values on tv.

Need option to create playlist. Currently we can only import playlist from YouTube and Spotify and for i really liked the authentic apple music ui so i didn't login to any of that platform listening directly but adding create playlist feature will really be a complete version of this banger app.

Support external browser login for Spotify or update internal WebView handling (HiBy DAP incompatibility). When trying to link a Spotify account via Connected Accounts in BitChord, the app attempts to open the Spotify login page using the system's internal WebView. Because of this outdated WebView version, the Spotify OAuth login page fails to process properly (the Continue button becomes unresponsive and text fields clear out), or if the system WebView is disabled, the app crashes instantly. Would it be possible to add an option to use an external web browser for the Spotify login/authentication flow instead of relying solely on the internal WebView?
An issue related to automix and song. Cuss words are getting muted and i dont see any option to turn that off. For Automix its not that seamless please make that better, overall the app is 11/10.

Hey! I've recently discovered BitChord and absolutely love the UI and the frosted-glass aesthetic. I'm considering switching from my current music player, but there are a few features I'd really love to see added. My feature suggestions: 1. Loop button — A dedicated repeat-one button to keep the current song playing on a loop, ideally alongside repeat-all. 2. Pitch control — Adjustable pitch independently of playback speed, with an option to preserve the original pitch when changing tempo. 3. Tempo control panel — A dedicated panel with adjustable playback speed and easy-to-use controls, preferably accessible directly from the Now Playing screen.

Add option to delete a specific track from cache. Currently, the app only allows users to clear all cached music at once. However, there is no way to delete an individual cached track. If a user dislikes a specific song or wants to free up space selectively, they cannot remove just that single track.

For songs without words, KuGou returns a single stamped line reading 纯音乐，请欣赏 (pure music, please enjoy), or a longer variant such as 此歌曲为没有填词的纯音乐，请您欣赏, and the app showed it as the song's lyrics. Treat notice as no lyrics.
Enable offline playback and downloads from cached songs. Previously could not play cached songs offline without network connection, and system cache cleared tracks during idle maintenance.
Fix radio queue ordering to prevent duplicate autoplay appends. Duplicate songs kept appending to autoplay radio queue.

Hii I really love the app but the only thing I wished it had was a repeat button. The app is wonderful but this is my only issue. I love listening to songs on repeat so I hope you guys can possibly add one on the shuffle button where we can press it to show it change to loop.

Playback speed option missing. BitChord v1.8 does not show any option to change playback speed. The app/repository lists Playback speed control (0.5x to 2.0x) as a feature, but I cannot find a speed control in the Now Playing screen, the three-dot menu, or in Settings.

Visual transitions & layout sync when opening artist page: The app loads metadata and assets sequentially across different platforms before settling down, causing too many harsh layout transitions. Displays YouTube Music picture first, switches to Apple Music, then plays Spotify Canvas.
Let us disable navigation tab titles and only keep icons so navigation bar is narrower and matches the playing bar.

Allow WAV files while keeping the 30-second minimum duration filter. As a music producer, I would like to be able to keep WAV files included in my music library while still ignoring audio files shorter than 30 seconds. Also noticed that a WAV file appears as RAW 24 bits 48.0 kHz in technical info.

Window minimum size exceeds display bounds and cannot be resized (JavaFX HiDPI / Window geometry issue). When launching BitChord, the application window opens with a hardcoded or saved minimum size that exceeds the display resolution. The window overflows the screen boundaries and controls are inaccessible.

Revisit a Lightweight Desktop Shell. The web client has evolved to rely heavily on the extension for essential functionality: stripping CORS to communicate with YouTube Music / Spotify endpoints, capturing session auth cookies, bridging Discord Rich Presence. A lightweight desktop wrapper eliminates extension dependency.
Adds Show Listen Together button under Settings Appearance. Turned off, the headphones + person capsule between the lyrics and queue glyphs isn't drawn to reduce player clutter.

Point the swipe hint the way the swipe skips. Dragging left on Now Playing skips to the next track, but the hint under the artwork showed the rewind glyph for it, and fast-forward for a drag to the right.
Downloaded tracks default to lower quality .webm format instead of expected high quality audio files, alongside strict path requirements for the download folder.
Missing Romanized lyrics toggle for non-Latin songs. Please add option to display phonetic English/Latin transliteration for Japanese, Korean, and other non-Latin languages.
Multi-language lyrics translation support. Would be great to see translated lyrics alongside the original language lines in real-time sync.
UI handling bug for RTL (Right-to-Left) languages where lyrics were incorrectly forced to right-align and broke syllable animation.
Large playlists with 400+ songs fail to completely load into the queue, capping out early or shifting into random suggestions and recommendations halfway through the playlist.
Experienced app pauses and freezes in the middle of tracks following recent updates, and desktop sign-in throws ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME errors.
Logging into Spotify integration causes stuttering and UI glitches, requiring manual workarounds using sp_dc browser cookie tokens.
Mid-stream quality transitions cause micro-pauses or slight playback hitches when switching between YouTube Music stream and lossless addon sources.
I wish the lyrics panel stayed open when transitioning to the next song instead of collapsing back down every time a track ends.
Audio focus issues: music fails to automatically resume after GPS voice navigation or phone call interruptions.
Love the Apple Music style UI, but there is no way to export playlists to standard m3u or backup custom playlists locally without cloud account.
The automix feature sounds cool on paper but in reality it abruptly cuts off song outros and messes up tempo on acoustic or slower tracks.
